name: 会話の呼びかけと反応の受信一覧
prompt:
Create a crisp Japanese mobile activity screen at exactly 390×800 pixels. Use reference image 1 as the exact source for the Japanese wording, 3-card content, positions, sizes and green brand header. Use reference image 2 for original iconography and visual context. Use reference image 3 for the original profile silhouette/status mark, image 4 for the first notification portrait, and image 5 for the second notification portrait. Do not copy English text from the source.

Preserve the native screen structure and wording exactly: dark solid green header with 新しい動き; profile control at x334 y14 size36×36; search field x16 y66 size358×40 with a search icon and placeholder 通知の位置へ移動・検索; tabs at y150 with labels すべて, 呼びかけ, 返信, 反応; three white notification cards at y206, y368 and y530; unread action 未読へ at x282 y748. Keep all card copy and timestamps exactly as shown in reference image 1, including the two identical 呼びかけ cards and one reaction card. Do not add any source-only rows or text.

Use the original source-style profile silhouette with a green online dot instead of the mint circle with initial あ. Use the exact original portrait from image 4 in the first card and image 5 in the second card; both are 36×36 rounded squares. Match source icon forms in filters: no icon on すべて, @ glyph for 呼びかけ, outlined chat bubble for 返信, and smile-plus glyph for 反応. Add a small @ glyph to the first card type label and a chat-bubble glyph to the second card type label. In the reaction card use a solid red heart matching the original, plus original thumbs-up and heart reaction emojis.

Color 交流のアイデア blue #1976D2 wherever it appears as a channel link, and color only 佐藤さん blue #1976D2 in each mention body. Keep all other text neutral: card labels and timestamps #6E6E6E, names/body #1D1D1D. Do not underline links. Remove mint tints: inactive tabs and 未読へ use white with a thin neutral #E8ECE9 outline; reaction chips use neutral gray #F2F2F2 with dark labels; search is white with a neutral border. Keep the solid dark green header and solid green selected すべて tab as brand/active state, and keep the green status dot.

No tinted surfaces, gradients, shadows, colored cards, extra controls or text. White card backgrounds, exact 390×800 layout and source-matching icons/portraits. Return only the flat screen.
reviewNotes: Solid green header/active tab, source profile and first two portraits, source navigation icon shapes, blue links, and untinted neutral controls are present. The reaction card incorrectly adds a third portrait, moves the solid heart into its heading, adds an unsupported timestamp, and shifts the lower content; retain needs-correction for one focused pass.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
